name: Terry Gou

summary.text: Terry Gou founded Hon Hai Precision Industry (Foxconn), the Taiwanese electronics manufacturer that assembles products for Apple, Google and Amazon and operates factories across China. In April 2019 he announced he would seek the opposition Nationalist Party (KMT) nomination for Taiwan's 2020 presidential election and step back from daily operations; at the June 2019 shareholders' meeting the board elected Young Liu, head of Foxconn's semiconductor division, as his successor, effective July 1, 2019.
